name: WAi1 Building 1

address.note: 37 Abernethy Road per src 3/4/8 (Baxtel lists 37-39 Abernethy Rd); site ~38,000-40,000 m2 fronting Abernethy Rd, Barker St and Brennan Way

lat.note: Geocoded 2026-09-27 from '37 Abernethy Road, Belmont WA 6104' with the ArcGIS World Geocoder (PointAddress, score 100). Campus-level point for 37-39 Abernethy Rd.

builder.note: named preferred contractor (media release, Aug 2023; iTnews 27 Jul 2023 src 1). No evidence a construction contract was executed or works started

developer.note: landowner/applicant Bulong Pty Ltd; planning consultant Urbis (src 8); GreenSquareDC acquired by Partners Group 2025 (src 6)

mw_it.note: 'two 48MW buildings, with approval to expand to 150MW' (iTnews). 96MW campus over two phases (src 8, 2)

cost_aud_m.note: campus-only figures, not split by building: total development cost incl. GST $1.1bn for all components / $968.4m local components (w.media, src 2, from the proponent's economic benefits statement); A$600m in the DA application reports (src 3, 8)

authority.value: Metro Inner-South Joint Development Assessment Panel (City of Belmont responsible authority)

pathway.note: JDAP; application described as two warehouse (data centre) buildings with administration, substation, generators (src 3/8)

reference.note: DAP reference not found: 2022 JDAP agendas/minutes are no longer online (DPLH archive is request-only), and the old dplh.wa.gov.au agenda URLs redirect

lodged.note: documents submitted to City of Belmont July 2022

determined.note: w.media 17 Oct 2022: panel 'today approved' the DA; Baxtel 24 Oct 2022 'approved ... earlier this month' (src 9). Approval period / expiry condition not verified (report not accessible)

jobs_construction_other.note: campus-wide (both buildings): '2,932 total full time equivalent construction job years supported both directly and indirectly'

jobs_operational.note: only a campus-wide direct+indirect figure available (see _other)

jobs_operational_other.note: campus-wide: 'the support of 180 ongoing jobs annually (directly and indirectly)'

construction_start.note: stage 1 was scheduled to start in 2023 (src 2); no evidence it started. Baxtel (2026) lists WAi1 as 'Withdrawn - Project cancelled before construction' (src 10)

open_questions: scope: likely out of scope - no evidence of construction start; Baxtel lists WAi1 as withdrawn/cancelled before construction and DCD (Jan 2026) notes GreenSquareDC's website no longer mentions it; whether the Oct 2022 approval has lapsed or was extended is unverified
DAP reference number and approval period/expiry condition not found (2022 JDAP report not online)
